title: ARWP AI Site Bootstrap Bundle
goal: Give an AI coding agent a deterministic starting point for preparing an existing website repository under ARWP without cargo-culting every optional surface.

bootstrapArtifacts.condition: target repository uses or benefits from coding-agent instructions
GitHub Actions is available and a deployed canonical URL exists

conditionalArtifacts.condition: organization or brand identity is materially useful
article/docs template has visible author/date/provenance fields
publisher/editorial site wants an explicit Google Preferred Sources CTA
publisher has an explicit AI-use policy and controls the authoritative robots/CDN layer
team wants a lightweight recurring Growth Profile artifact
team wants recurring actionable GitHub issues and accepts write permissions

neverDo: add FAQ schema solely for ranking hopes
claim ARWP or special AI files guarantee ranking/citation/recommendation
mark runtime/browser checks passed without runtime evidence
treat public observation as publisher adoption
